comparison.objective: Open a can with a handheld rotary opener; the candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain handle squeeze while repeatedly regrasping and turning a feed key versus hold a driver setting while tightening a concentric jam nut.
comparison.success_condition: Lid is cut all around, opener removed, and can upright; candidate requires a precise locked angle and repeated return with low drift.
comparison.reason: The tasks share generic bimanual hold-and-turn primitives, but continuous cutting under clamp force is meaningfully different from preserving an adjustable setting during locknut tightening.
